say:2:1330377001:1.text: Take it easy! The undead can't recognize anyone. They're liable to attack first.
say:2:1330377001:1.source_cn: 冷静些！活死人已经失去了意识，认不出你来，甚至会攻击你的！
say:2:1330377001:1.male: Take it easy! The undead can't recognize anyone. They're liable to attack first.
say:2:1330377001:1.female: Take it easy! The undead can't recognize anyone. They're liable to attack first.

say:3:1330377002:1.text: He saved my life. I'm an old man now. Why not take a gamble?
say:3:1330377002:1.source_cn: 我这条命是他救的，垂垂老矣还给他又何妨！

say:4:1330377003:1.text: Dura above! Will somebody please stop this old codger before he does something foolish?
say:4:1330377003:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，谁来拦住这老头子……
